prerequisites: Prior knowledge of the Graphic Expression course

learning_outcomes.text: Interpret and represent engineering structure and installation plans.
Correctly use specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards for the graphic representation of industrial installations.
Customize CAD applications oriented to installations and specific drawings.
Organize and manage CAD systems in companies.
Exchange drawing files between applications and via the Internet.

syllabus_topics: Software CAD / BIM / MEP / Visualization / Animation / Simulation.
BIM systems. Parametric modeling of structures and architecture.
Scientific visualization. Animation and Simulation of 3D Models.
Exchange of drawing files between different computer applications.
Principles of dimensioning applied to industrial installations. Standards.

assessment_methods.method: Exercises, work and/or presentations developed during the course (Individual project)
Active student participation in the development of the course. Correct completion of proposed exercises during the course.

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.75 * EV2 + 0.25 * EV4, where EV2 is the individual project (content 5 points, presentation 2.5 points) and EV4 is active participation (2.5 points). Students must attend at least 80% of practical classes (classroom and laboratory) to be evaluated in continuous assessment; otherwise, they will be considered not presented. If minimums are not met, the final grade will be the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0. For extraordinary evaluation, students must resubmit a corrected or new personal project. Differentiated evaluation allows participation via the virtual campus and requires a personal project.
